what: Behind the panel, the image (photo · video · canvas, or the skin color gradient if none) is shown as if through wet shower glass — two layers of round droplets sit on each cell (large: 30 cells · 22% placement · radius .16~.32, small: 70 cells · 55% · .18~.36), and in every 7.5% band of the panel width a raindrop (radius .008~.02, 58% chance) falls, accelerating at .10~.22 turns per second, leaving shrinking trail droplets where it passed. Droplets refract the image (height × .8, max .02) and add an upper-left light glint and a bluish edge rim. The image is not blurred. Pauses when off screen

options.big · big-amount: Big bubble cell count · position ratio, default 30 · .22
options.small · small-amount: Number of small bubbles / slot ratio, default 70·.55
options.lane · speed-min · speed-max · rain-gap: Rain-line band width (ratio to panel height) · speed lower limit · upper limit · empty band ratio, default .075 · .1 · .22 · .42
options.[data-fx-part=source]: (If present) image img · video · canvas behind the glass — fitted with cover
options.--fx-top · --fx-bottom · --fx-glow: Gradient top and bottom colors and top-left light when there is no image (CSS variables)

use: …Footer content…
